properties.name: FIELD REPORT (bhome S3, 2026-09-18): the plan-sheet generator reads geometry from the IFC and the budget from design-facts.json, a hand transcription of budget_report, 'because reflow2 is an MCP server and not a library the script can import' — so the half of the sheet reflow2 owns is the half with no mechanical guarantee. MEASURED: the CLI has --export, --export-snapshot, --import, --diff and --merge-driver, and no one-shot door to a report
properties.source: bhome feedback.md, Session 3 (2026-09-18), triaged 2026-09-19 through the triage-feedback skill
properties.statement: Reporter: 'If a contribution moves in the graph and nobody re-exports that file, the sheet prints the old number and looks exactly as confident as before … Opportunity: something that exports a budget as data a build can consume, so a derived document can cite the graph the way it cites the model.' MEASURED: main.rs long flags — no --call, no --report; a build script's only door to budget_report is a JSON-RPC session over stdio (tools/smoke_mcp.py is one, undocumented as a consumer door). PRECEDENT: dec:idea-outward-docs-are-rendered-from-the-graph (2026-08-11, 'already the recorded direction, and it is unbuilt') and the export write-through (the server keeps one derived file current). CAUSE: derived views leave the graph only through an agent or a hand; the one file the server keeps current is the export.
